name: search_mathlib
description: 在固定 mathlib 的 Lean 源码中搜索正则表达式，返回至多 100 行。

name: read_mathlib
description: 读取固定 mathlib 中一个 Mathlib/...lean 文件的指定行。

name: read_task_input
description: Read an explicitly frozen task document by ID; no other local files are accessible.

name: read_yui
description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

name: check_artifact
description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

name: submit_artifact
description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

name: report_obstacle
description: Report exact status, location, explanation, basis, partial_progress. SUBSTANTIVE_GAP or SUSPECTED_GAP stops for an actual unsupported mathematical implication; give its premises, conclusion and mathematical grounds. SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or INPUT_CONFLICT stops for a real source-access/original-input obstacle. Ordinary unfinished drafting, source registration or format work must use TASK_INCOMPLETE: this records progress without ending the stage; continue the actual work. Difficulty or artifact incompletion alone is not a mathematical gap.

name: check_draft
description: Preferred structured-object form of check_artifact: provide artifact as an actual JSON object, not an escaped JSON string. Same complete validation and acceptance scope.

name: submit_draft
description: Preferred structured-object form of submit_artifact: provide artifact as an actual JSON object, not an escaped JSON string. Same complete validation and acceptance scope.

name: check_lean_types
description: Compile a partial mathematical definition header and selected Lean type expressions with explicit parameters. Type-only scratch work: never accepts a final interface or adds a proved premise.
